tenderSchedule.title: Cleaning and maintenance of Pay-and-Use Toilets, Free Urinal Blocks, and the entire bus stand premises, including indoor passenger waiting areas, open spaces, outdoor premises, platforms, front areas of commercial establishments, and all other areas within the bus stand premises, shall come under the jurisdiction of KKRTC BASAVANA BAGEWADI DEPOT

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall upload the Registration Certificate (Form-C) obtained from the Labour Department under the provisions of the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961, along with the e-Tender bid

The bidder shall be registered with the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Departments. The relevant registration certificates shall be uploaded along with the e-Tender bid.

The bidder shall submit an Affidavit on a Stamp Paper of 100/-, declaring that the bidder has not been blacklisted by the State Government / various Government Departments / Corporations / Boards. The affidavit shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure 1
